text: The Investment Committee recommends increasing the previously-approved investment from $2,500,000 Net to $2,841,800 Net ($3,363,800 Gross). The increase is based on similar potential for risk-adjusted return and an increased potential for impact aligned with Toronto Atmospheric Fund's mandate.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved an investment of up to net $2,841,800 and gross $3,363,800 subject to the terms and conditions outlined by the Investment Committee at its meeting of 10 December 2020 and as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 22, 2021) from the Vice President, Impact Investing. 2. Directed the Vice President, Impact Investing to implement the investment to the satisfaction of Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Solicitor. 3. If deemed necessary by the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, in consultation with the City Solicitor, requested, via the City Manager, Council approval for the investment as it exceeds $2,000,000. 4.
